tool_schemas.name: search_flight_offers
tool_schemas.description: Executes an Amadeus flight-offers search on behalf of the given workspace and API key, persists a new search record with the stored default_search_config and the raw amadeus_request, and returns the persisted search plus the offers returned by Amadeus. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id or api_key_id do not match the required formats, if amadeus_request is missing/empty, or if any unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or API key does not exist (or the API key is not owned by the workspace). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is disabled or not permitted for flight shopping, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED (or RATE_LIMITED) when the API key’s quota/rate limits would be exceeded, in which case no search is recorded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the search and resulting offers.

api_key_id.description: API key id to use for the Amadeus request (used for auth, quota enforcement, and accounting).

trigger_source.description: Origin of the search invocation for audit/debug purposes.

default_search_config.description: Default search configuration applied by the server (stored on the search record).

amadeus_request.description: Raw Amadeus flight-offers search request payload to execute and persist.

tool_schemas.name: list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces visible to the caller. Returns a paginated list and refuses invalid pagination parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

name_prefix.description: Filter to workspaces whose name starts with this prefix (case-insensitive).

created_after.description: Only return workspaces created after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Only return workspaces created before this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new stored Amadeus API key credential for a workspace. Persists the client_secret encrypted, initializes quota counters, and returns the created api_keys record. Refuses if the workspace does not exist, is not active, or if fields are invalid.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that will own this API key.

name.description: Human-friendly name for this key (for audit/UI).

amadeus_environment.description: Amadeus environment this credential is valid for.

client_secret.description: Amadeus API client secret. Stored encrypted and never returned.

daily_request_limit.description: Per-day request cap for this key. 0 means unlimited.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the API key. Cannot be set to revoked at creation.

tool_schemas.name: rotate_api_key_secret
tool_schemas.description: Rotates (replaces) the stored client_secret for an existing API key without changing its id. Returns the updated api_keys record. Refuses if the API key is revoked, the workspace is deleted, or the new secret is invalid.

api_key_id.description: API key id whose secret will be rotated.

client_secret.description: New Amadeus API client secret. Stored encrypted and never returned.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates the lifecycle status of an API key (enable/disable/revoke). Returns the updated api_keys record. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., revoked -> active) and refuses if the key is already revoked.

status.description: New status for the API key.

tool_schemas.name: list_flight_offer_searches
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted flight-offer searches for a workspace, optionally filtered by API key and status. Returns a paginated list and refuses invalid filters or pagination parameters.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose searches will be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of searches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

api_key_id.description: Filter searches executed using this API key id.

trigger_source.description: Filter by origin of the search invocation.

created_after.description: Only return searches created after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Only return searches created before this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: get_flight_offer_search
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a persisted flight-offer search by id, including its stored sanitized amadeus_request and amadeus_response, and optionally its associated offers. Refuses if ids are malformed or the search does not belong to the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the search.

search_id.description: Flight offer search id to fetch.

include_offers.description: If true, also return the persisted flight_offers for this search.

offers_limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return when include_offers is true.

offers_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for offers when include_offers is true.

metadata.name: Amadeus MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores authenticated access to the Amadeus flight shopping API through an MCP server, tracking API keys, each flight-offer search request, the resulting offers returned by Amadeus, and usage/accounting for rate limits and cost control.
